verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published delegation framework: no third-party authorization forms, no defined roles for filers or agents, and no statement of which signatures must stay personal. The only related item is a 'Mass change registered agent (PDF)' form title, which says nothing about the scope of third-party authority. Delegated access is a fair axis for a state business registry, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
